rationale: Fault currents were computed by summing source, transformer, and feeder impedance to each fault location. The maximum three-phase fault is at the near-bus fault, the minimum two-phase fault is at the remote end, 12.5 kA is the smallest standard breaker rating above the 1.1 safety margin, and 600 A is between the 450 A load-margin minimum and the 754.05 A sensitivity maximum.
